final: WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) AS simple_mean FROM type_rates) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / simple_mean AS relative_to_mean FROM type_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_spending_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY type
